files.purpose_guess: Cutting propagation log (batch ID, species, collection locality, numbers, pricked-out date, container, strike rate), one of several archived snapshots; the most complete of the 2022 snapshots.

sheets.name: Sheet1
sheets.grain: One cutting batch (one species from one source locality propagated on one date), with a single pricked-out event and a survival tally. Some batches span 2-3 rows via merged cells to record staged pricking-out or potting.

columns.notes: Cutting batch ID. Early rows C1..C~260 run in sequence; later rows use C+YYMMDD (C220607 = 7 Jun 2022). Treated as the batch key (seed_source_code candidate, low confidence). Duplicates: C30, C42, C58, C138, C254, C258. Trailing spaces e.g. 'C3 '.

Free text. Includes genus-only entries, '?' uncertainty, informal morphotypes, wood-hardness notes, and Māori common names used as the species (Matai, Totara, Rata). Red font on 755 cells across the sheet (meaning not documented).

SENSITIVE: where the cuttings were taken (abbreviations and place names). 455 non-null rows. Mixed abbreviations and full names for the same place, with trailing spaces. Not a planting site. Values withheld.
Number of cuttings set. 411 int, 40 text ('~30' approximate, 40 cells in D3:D468).
Date propagated. Range 2010-11-02 (E364) to 2027-08-21 (E145); both look like typos. Genuine range roughly 2016-07 to 2022-06.
Pricked-out date. 320 dates, 19 text: 'dead' (6), '?' (5), and multi-date strings e.g. F61, F36 uses a second row. Stage 2 transition.
Count after pricking out. 313 int, 35 text ('-' 20, paired values such as '27 22' in G35, '55  9' in G61).

Container. Mixed vocabulary: named trays (V150, PB3, RX90), bare numbers (7, 90, 5 = tray/pot codes), '1L', pairs ('5,7'). 40 floats in this column look like ratios that have slipped from column J (e.g. 0.8, 0.77, 0.55), so they are misplaced values.

Free text: propagation notes, medium, potting-on dates ('28 into PB3 20/9/17'), cross-references to other batches. Also holds initials/first names of people (HM 84 rows, others) - volunteer/propagator name present, values withheld. Mixed with comments in the same column.
Unlabelled strike-rate ratio (0-1). Approximately equals G/D in 139 of 173 checkable rows; 34 rows differ (e.g. J7, J13, J33). Typed in, not a formula.
Stray annotations in 10 cells (K100, K103, K144, K173, K188, K249-K251, K257, K262). Includes 'PB3 10/9/19' potting-on notes.

quality_issues.issue: Species free text: genus-only, '?' uncertainty, typos (Camichaelia), morphotypes, notes inside the name, trailing spaces; 143 distinct values for roughly 14 genera clusters
Header row 2 with 'Cuttings at' and a date serial in row 1 (A1:B1); two columns both headed '#' (D2, G2, reported as error cells by the profiler)

open_questions_for_wrt: Is the cutting log still live? Which file is the current one, and does the 2025 .xlsx supersede the Archive copies?
What do the Site abbreviations in column C mean, and are they cutting-collection localities only, or ever planting sites? Is a lookup list held elsewhere?
Does the unlabelled column J mean strike rate (survivors / cuttings set), and should the typed-in values or G/D be trusted where they differ?
What do the red and blue font colours mean in column B and row 138?
How should Pot size codes 7, 90, 5 and RX90 be read (tray type, cell count or pot size)?
Are the 2010-11-02 and 2027-08-21 propagation dates typos, and what were the intended dates?
Do cutting batch IDs (C1..C2206xx) link to any other record, such as the seed collecting record or the pricking-out list, and why do the last IDs in the newer snapshots restart at low numbers?
Is cutting-propagated stock counted in the pricking-out list, or recorded only here?
